name: Geeker the trader
teaser: Basically a trader helping you early game with mid gear, or whatever.
description_html:
DOES NOT WORK WITH 3.10 AT THE CURRENT MOMENT WAIT FOR 2.0.0
Geeker is meant to be a trader selling you decent tier gear at decent prices (at least what i can see is fair) and might actually be useful early game before unlocking the flea. Most items are just slightly cheaper than the other prices of other traders like the medkits or something

Loyalty Levels:

LL1:

  • Level 1
  • 0 Spending
  • 0 Standing

LL2:

  • Level 24
  • 1.5 Mil Spending
  • 0 Standing

LL3:

  • Level 31
  • 2.1 Mil Spending
  • 0 Standing

Many thanks to some members of the spt community and many others for helping out when I first started this mod.

Feel free to tag me on the spt discord:drift_9715 for any questions and stuff

HOW TO INSTALL:

Unzip the folder with 7zip or something

THEN

Drag and drop the user folder on your spt directory
